<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1758202_demo.FieldUpdater</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>FieldUpdater</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var FieldUpdater = Class.create();
FieldUpdater.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    updateField: function() {
        var tableName = this.getParameter('sysparm_table');
        var sysId = this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id');
        var fieldValue = this.getParameter('sysparm_field_value');
        
        try {
            var gr = new GlideRecord(tableName);
            if (gr.get(sysId)) {
                gr.your_field = fieldValue; // 替换为你的字段名
                if (gr.update()) {
                    return 'success';
                }
            }
            return 'failed';
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('字段更新失败: ' + e.message);
            return 'error';
        }
    }
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-06-05 08:01:22</sys_created_on><sys_id>73fecc04970ee2101c50f91de053af46</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>FieldUpdater</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Demo" source="x_1758202_demo">f06f80349735ae501c50f91de053afca</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Demo">f06f80349735ae501c50f91de053afca</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_73fecc04970ee2101c50f91de053af46</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-06-05 08:01:22</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
